say:0:1022056001:0.text: I remember her saying how much she adores the blue flowers here.
say:0:1022056001:0.source_cn: 我记得她提到过，她一直非常欣赏此处的蓝色花朵。
say:0:1022056001:0.male: I remember her saying how much she adores the blue flowers here.
say:0:1022056001:0.female: I remember her saying how much she adores the blue flowers here.

say:1:1022056002:0.text: I'll make sure the color of the petals never fades...
say:1:1022056002:0.source_cn: 那么，就让这海洋般的深蓝，永恒地停留在这花瓣上……
say:1:1022056002:0.male: I'll make sure the color of the petals never fades...
say:1:1022056002:0.female: I'll make sure the color of the petals never fades...
